shared_elements: human/anthropomorphic head or figure in stone carving
incised hatched or netted patterning on a surface
justification: A is a single three-dimensional head with heavy brows, hollow eyes and a cap or headdress bearing incised cross-hatching, shown in isolation; B is a shallow relief frieze of a procession of standing figures in profile leading a two-humped camel, framed above and below by rosette bands. Beyond the fact that both depict human features and some incised hatched texture, there is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement — one is an isolated sculptural face, the other a narrative processional register.
